answer.rationale: Hard constraint is do not raise delivery risk: line is at 94% with no buffer and the primary contract dies in 14 days with no auto-renew. memory_c1 is the only inherited record that keeps integration and deliveries intact. Incumbent already refused a price reopen, so negotiate_terms is unlikely to land an 18% cut before expiry; deferral is not analogous to the non-critical month-to-month case; add_second_source does not replace the expiring primary. Switch could cut unit cost but would introduce onboarding/delivery risk this cycle—memory_c2 is the load-bearing counter-claim, so it is the one record to verify. Renewing preserves supply; cost-cut options wait until that claim is checked or the next review.
